draft.reply_body:
Hi Ville,

Thanks for your patience on the floor saw claim — I've now been through the details. Because the blade and guard damage happened while cutting beyond the saw's stated maximum depth, that falls outside what the Damage Waiver Cover protects: operating equipment beyond its stated working limits isn't covered. So I'm afraid the €260 repair cost won't be covered by the waiver and will need to be charged to your account.

On the generator — yes, we do have 20kVA diesel units. Let me know the dates you need it for and I'll check what's available.

Best regards,
Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager
